reasoning: The eval was run to serve as the artifact that would prove the cut safe, but its own record says a one-scenario gap is inside producer variance (~2 scenarios) — the check did not actually settle whether the shorter skill costs anything. Closing here would mean the Director choosing, on its own, to trade 3.7KB of front-door length against an unproven and possibly real quality loss with no artifact able to confirm which version is truly as good. An ordinary delivered result closes automatically only when a command, test, or plain read already confirms delivery; here the test explicitly disclaims that power over a gap this size. This lands in the trade-off-no-artifact-settles bucket rule 12/27 reserve for the human — the Director shows both scores and the variance caveat and holds the checkpoint open for his word.
